title: Senior Level Designer
description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

 

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration


\n
$115,000 - $149,500 a year

Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.

description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

  • Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

  • Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. ROLE OVERVIEW

The Solutions Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring Benchling solution development, coverage, efficacy, quality, and enablement across the Customer Experience team. Operating at the intersection of our product suite and our customers, this dynamic role focuses on translating our product capabilities into effective solutions to match our customers' scientific use cases, and enabling the broader CX organization to operationalize around Benchling's best practices. Successful Solutions Delivery Managers will harness the knowledge and experience Benchling has gained across thousands of customer engagements, and leverage previous and learned experience to serve as an expert across scientific domains and modalities served by Benchling. HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Product Manager
description:
About Lio

Build AI that runs inside the world's largest enterprises.

Everyone is building AI. Very few are making it work at enterprise scale.

At Lio, we're building the AI workforce for procurement. Our AI agents automate complex, mission-critical workflows across procurement, logistics, and finance for some of the world's largest companies.

Backed by leading investors including a16z and Y Combinator, we're growing fast and tackling some of the most complex challenges in enterprise AI.

We're looking for people who want to take ownership, solve hard problems, and build technology that delivers real business impact.

The Role

We're looking for a Product Manager – Pre-Sales & Go-to-Market who can bridge the gap between what enterprise customers need, what our engineers build, and how we bring our products to market.

At Lio, product decisions don't happen in isolation. Every customer conversation, sales cycle, and implementation reveals new opportunities to make our AI agents more valuable.

Your mission is to turn those insights into action.

You'll work directly with our Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Implementation teams to understand customer needs, shape product positioning, strengthen our go-to-market strategy, and identify opportunities that drive revenue.

You'll be deeply involved in enterprise sales cycles, helping our teams communicate the value of our AI agents, build compelling business cases, and win customers.

This isn't traditional Product Management.

Our engineers own their features and make most product decisions. You won't manage a backlog or spend your time writing detailed specifications.

Instead, you'll provide the customer context, commercial insights, and clear recommendations that help our engineers build the right things and our Sales team sell them effectively.

We care about real customer value and commercial outcomes, not features that look impressive but never get used.

What You'll Do

  • Connect product and go-to-market: Work across Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Implementation to align customer needs, product capabilities, and commercial opportunities.

  • Get close to customers: Participate in enterprise discovery calls, demos, workshops, and sales conversations to understand buying criteria, pain points, and emerging use cases.

  • Enable our Sales team: Develop compelling product messaging, use-case positioning, business cases, and sales materials that translate technical capabilities into measurable business value.

  • Turn market insights into product improvements: Collect customer feedback, analyze win/loss patterns, and identify recurring opportunities for new or improved AI agents.

  • Influence product decisions: Work directly with engineers to clarify customer problems, validate opportunities, and recommend priorities based on commercial potential and customer impact.

  • Own product knowledge: Build and maintain the product and go-to-market knowledge base used by our teams and internal AI systems, ensuring capabilities, use cases, and proof points stay accurate.

  • Analyze commercial performance: Understand how our products perform across customer segments, sales cycles, usage, and revenue.

  • Improve pricing and packaging: Identify opportunities to strengthen our commercial offering, increase conversion, and unlock expansion.

  • Understand the market: Stay close to competitors, industry developments, and emerging customer requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Consulting, Pre-Sales, or a comparable customer-facing role.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within a fast-growing startup or scale-up selling to enterprise customers.

  • Direct involvement in enterprise sales cycles, including discovery, demos, business cases, and commercial discussions.

  • Strong technical understanding and experience working closely with engineering teams.

  • Familiarity with AI and LLM-based products and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value.

  • Strong commercial judgment and an understanding of what drives customer adoption, conversion, and revenue.

  • Analytical skills and the ability to turn customer feedback, market signals, and performance data into clear recommendations.

  • Excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus.

  • A proactive, hands-on mindset with high ownership and the confidence to challenge assumptions.

  • Experience using AI tools in your daily work.

Procurement experience is a plus, but not required. We're looking for someone who can quickly understand a complex market and connect customer needs with real business opportunities.

Why Join Lio?

  • Shape how enterprise AI reaches the market: Influence both our product direction and how we position and sell our AI agents.

  • Work at the intersection of product and revenue: Your work will directly contribute to winning customers and growing our business.

title: Product Manager
description:
About Lio

Build AI that runs inside the world's largest enterprises.

Everyone is building AI. Very few are making it work at enterprise scale.

At Lio, we're building the AI workforce for procurement. Our AI agents automate complex, mission-critical workflows across procurement, logistics, and finance for some of the world's largest companies.

Backed by leading investors including a16z and Y Combinator, we're growing fast and tackling some of the most complex challenges in enterprise AI.

We're looking for people who want to take ownership, solve hard problems, and build technology that delivers real business impact.

The Role

We're looking for a Product Manager – Post-Sales & Customer Value who wants to make enterprise AI genuinely useful at scale.

Getting AI agents into production is only the beginning. What matters is what happens next: Are customers actually using them? Are workflows becoming more efficient? Are we delivering measurable business value?

Your mission is to connect what happens in real customer environments with how we continuously improve our products.

You'll work closely with Implementation Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Customer Success, and our engineering teams to identify adoption barriers, improve existing agents, and turn individual customer learnings into scalable product improvements.

Product Management at Lio works differently.

Our engineers own their features and make most product decisions. You won't spend your days managing backlogs, writing lengthy specifications, or assigning tickets.

Instead, you'll bring customer insights, usage data, and commercial context to the table, enabling engineers and implementation teams to make better decisions.

Your success is measured by the value our customers actually receive.

What You'll Do

  • Drive customer adoption: Work with Implementation and Customer Success teams to ensure customers successfully adopt our AI agents and integrate them into everyday workflows.

  • Turn deployments into insights: Identify recurring implementation challenges, configuration issues, and product gaps across enterprise customers.

  • Understand product performance: Analyze usage, adoption, automation rates, workflow completion, and time-to-value to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Connect customers with engineering: Establish regular feedback loops with users, implementation teams, and engineers to understand what works and what needs to change.

  • Influence product decisions: Translate customer challenges into clear, evidence-based recommendations for improving existing agents and developing new capabilities.

  • Build scalable knowledge: Own and continuously improve our product and implementation knowledge base, including deployment playbooks, best practices, and internal AI knowledge systems.

  • Identify expansion opportunities: Recognize where additional capabilities can increase customer value, retention, and account expansion.

  • Measure impact: Validate whether product improvements lead to better adoption, stronger automation outcomes, and measurable customer value.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in Product Management, Implementation, Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, or a comparable role.

  • Experience in a fast-moving B2B SaaS startup or scale-up, ideally serving enterprise customers.

  • Direct exposure to post-sales customer journeys, including implementations, adoption, retention, or expansion.

  • Strong communication skills in English; German is a plus.

  • A hands-on, customer-first mindset with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently and solve problems.

Experience in procurement is a plus, but not required. What matters most is your ability to understand complex customer problems and turn them into meaningful product improvements.

Why Join Lio?

  • Shape enterprise AI adoption: Help define how some of the world's largest companies successfully deploy and use AI agents.

  • Direct product impact: Your insights will influence what we build and how our products evolve.

  • Work with exceptional engineers: Collaborate with product-minded builders who move fast and take ownership of their work.

  • See measurable results: Connect your work directly to customer outcomes, adoption, retention, and revenue.

If you care more about real customer impact than managing roadmaps, we'd love to meet you.

title: Sales Executive, DACH
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package with On-Target Earnings (OTE), designed to reward high performance and results. This includes a strong base salary complemented by an uncapped commission structure, meaning there is no limit to what you can earn — your success directly drives your income. Top performers have the opportunity to significantly exceed OTE, supported by a transparent, performance-driven bonus plan that truly rewards achievement.

 

Building on this performance-driven culture, not every candidate ticks every box — and that’s why we value individuals with a growth mindset who bring potential, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

  • Experience with EMI/EMC mitigation techniques

  • Familiarity with design for test, manufacturability, assembly, and reliability 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Python, C++, or other programming languages 
  • Experience with large, deployable antenna arrays which drive your vision for the next generation of on-orbit communications and sensor arrays.

  • PCBA experience.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Win new restaurants across Germany and help build one of our fastest-growing markets from the ground up.

Full-time

About SOUS

SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.

Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.

We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa.

About the role

SOUS helps independent food and beverage entrepreneurs grow by building what we believe will be the last employee a restaurant owner ever has to hire that touches a screen. After a strong start in the Netherlands, Germany is now one of our most important growth markets, and we are scaling our team there quickly.

Your team

Tasks

Your role in this growth

  • Focus fully on new business and drive consistent growth in the single and multi-outlet restaurant segments in Germany

  • Build and manage a strong outbound and inbound pipeline in the German food and beverage market

Benefits

title: Account Executive (m/w/d) Legal Tech – DACH
description:
Where Legal Leads. 

Drei Worte. Eine Überzeugung. Rechtsabteilungen sind nicht länger die Bremse im Unternehmen – sie sind der Hebel. Bei DiliTrust geben wir ihnen die Plattform, die diesem Anspruch gerecht wird: Verträge, Beteiligungen, Vorstandsarbeit und Legal AI – eine integrierte Suite für die gesamte Rechtsfunktion. Im Einsatz bei mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen in 64 Ländern, darunter führende Konzerne in Europa, Nordamerika und MEA. 

DACH ist unser nächster großer Wachstumsmarkt. Die Basis steht, jetzt skalieren wir. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Territory, baust deine Strategie eigenständig auf und entscheidest, wo du wachsen willst – unterstützt von einem Team aus Solution Consultants, BDR, Marketing und Customer Success, das in DACH bereits liefert. 

Der Legal-Tech-Markt ist über 16 Milliarden Dollar schwer und wächst jedes Jahr zweistellig. In zwei Jahren wirst du auf diesen Moment zurückblicken. 

Die Frage ist nur: Warst du dabei? 


Deine Rolle 
 

Du verantwortest ein eigenes Vertical in DACH, z.B. Financial Services, Energy, Manufacturing oder Pharma. Dein Fokus liegt auf Neukundengewinnung und gezieltem Cross-Sell in deinem bestehenden Portfolio. 

  • Du identifizierst und qualifizierst neue Opportunities, gemeinsam mit deinem BDR, über Anfragen, Marketing und gezielte Ansprache. 

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch. Du baust deinen Territory Plan auf, entwickelst Account Plans für deine Top-Targets und treibst gemeinsam mit deinem BDR fokussierte Pod Sprints in deinem Vertical. 

  • Deine Deals liegen typischerweise zwischen 50.000 € und 200.000 € Jahresvolumen. Sales-Cycles dauern 4–9 Monate. Pro Deal sprichst du mit 4–7 Entscheidern: Legal, IT, Einkauf, Finance, manchmal Vorstand. 

  • Du verkaufst eine Plattform, kein Einzelprodukt. Erstgespräche führen oft Legal Ops Manager oder General Counsel. Deals über mehrere Module sind bei uns die Regel. 

  • Du repräsentierst DiliTrust auf den wichtigen Branchen-Events wie z.B. Legal Revolution oder LegalTech. Du führst dort die Gespräche, die später zu Pipeline werden. 


Must-have

  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im quotaverantwortlichen B2B-Software-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld. 

  • Erfahrung in komplexen Sales-Cycles mit mehreren Entscheidern aus Legal, IT, Finance oder Procurement. 

  • Methodisches Arbeiten: Du qualifizierst sauber (z. B. mit MEDDPICC) und führst belastbare Forecasts. 

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an C-Level-Entscheider. 

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachen-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch – unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. 


Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an Rechts-, Governance- oder Compliance-Funktionen. 

  • Du kennst die Welt regulierter Branchen - Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare oder Pharma. 

  • Du hast bereits eigenständig ein Territory aufgebaut – mit klarer Account-Strategie und nachhaltigem Pipeline-Aufbau. 

  • Du interessierst dich für KI im Unternehmenskontext  und kannst Kunden den Unterschied zwischen Hype und echtem Mehrwert erklären. 


Was wir dir bieten

  • Remote-First. Du arbeitest von zuhause oder in unseren Offices in München und Berlin - regelmäßige Team-Events bringen uns offline zusammen. 

  • Onboarding und Ramp-Up, das zu einem komplexen Produkt passt. Produkt, Branche und Methodik step by step - mit erfahrenen Teamkollegen, die dich auf Tempo bringen. 

  • Ehrliches Coaching, präsenter Sales Manager. Wir sind 7 Leute im DACH-Sales, keine Nummer in einer großen Maschine. Regelmäßige Einzelgespräche, gemeinsame Deal-Reviews. Wenn du gut bist, wird das gesehen. Wenn etwas hakt, wird darüber gesprochen. 

  • Karriereperspektive in einer Wachstumsregion. Senior AE, Enterprise AE, Team Lead DACH: wir bauen die Region aktiv aus, nicht ab. 

  • Internationales Setup, lokaler Fokus. Dein Spielfeld ist DACH, aber wenn dich die Lust auf Mailand, Madrid oder Mexico City packt, kannst du auch von dort arbeiten. 

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Zulage für Heimarbeit und weitere Vorteile folgen in Kürze! 


Dein Weg zu uns

  1. Erstgespräch mit dem Recruiting-Team (30 Min, auf Englisch) – wir lernen uns kennen, klären gegenseitige Erwartungen. 

  1. Interview mit dem Sales Manager DACH (45 Min) – Deep Dive in deine Erfahrung, deine Methodik und Fit für die Rolle. 

  1. Interview mit dem Global Chief Sales Officer (45 Min) – Strategie, Karriereperspektive, Final-Check. 

  1. Kurzes Rollenspiel (45 Min) – eine realistische Sales-Situation, an der wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Du bekommst Briefing und Vorbereitungszeit. 

Bist du bereit, bei uns einzusteigen?

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – wenn möglich auf Englisch – ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wenn du vorab Fragen hast: ----- oder sende eine LinkedIn-Nachricht an Fabian Pohl.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung.

Hinweis: Wir nutzen KI-gestützte Tools zur Vorauswahl von Bewerbungen. Die endgültige Entscheidung trifft immer ein Mensch.

title: Publishing Product Director
description:
As Publishing Product Director, you are the creative custodian of one of Crytek’s games, embedded inside the game team, accountable for protecting the creative vision and translating the promise of the game into work that the publishing team can execute with conviction. The success of a great game depends on the work that surrounds it landing as truthfully as the game itself, and closing that gap is what this role exists to do. You make sure that what reaches players is authentic, aspirational, tells the story the game deserves, and delights the players who play it. 

The game in your remit is an unannounced project in the Crytek portfolio. The work focuses on shaping the project’s player promise from the inside out, defining the publishing narrative for its eventual reveal, and carrying its creative vision through to launch and into ongoing releases. 

You sit inside the game team, working shoulder-to-shoulder with game leadership every day. You partner directly with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to support both the game and the business as one connected effort. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth. 

This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. You will protect the team from noise so they can build the game, and you will give the publishing team the clarity, player insight, and creative truth they need to land it well. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding. 


What You'll Do
  • Be the custodian of the game’s creative vision, tone, and player promise, and translate it into work that publishing can execute with conviction
  • Sit embedded inside the game team and act as the daily bridge between game leadership and the publishing organisation  
  • Serve as the source of truth on what the game is, what is coming next, and what it means for players, across Marketing, Comms, Community, and Commercial  
  • Brief and review every major marketing, comms, and community output for creative authenticity, ensuring it tells the right player story  
  • Partner with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to shape go-to-market plans that serve the game and the business in equal measure  
  • Drive franchise narrative, player promise, and creative direction across reveals, beats, and post-launch moments  
  • Protect the game team from operational noise so they can focus on building, while translating publishing priorities into work the team can act on  
  • Keep the north star intact on both ends, keeping publishing grounded in the game’s vision, and the game team grounded in player and market reality  

    • What You Bring
  • 8+ years working at the seam between game development and publishing or marketing, with significant time embedded inside game teams
  • Proven ability to translate creative vision into commercial activation without compromising either side, with strong creative judgement and editorial instinct you can defend under pressure  
  • Fluency across business models (premium, live service, DLC, F2P) and multi-year roadmap strategy, and how the two shape the player promise

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Platform  (f/m/d)
description:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform 

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About the role 

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

 

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. 
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 
  • Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. 
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. 
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

 

Where you'll work from 

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

title: Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d)
description:
Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d) to help us make Apaleo compliant, fast, wherever we grow next. You'll own the delivery of features that keep our platform compliant across markets, working closely with a Senior Product Management Lead who sets the strategic direction for the wider fiscal and tax domain. 

 

What You'll Be Up To 

  • Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation. 
  • Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against. 
  • Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched. 
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. 
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. 
  • Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. 
  • Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. 
  • Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. 

 

What You'll Bring to the Team 

  • At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. 
  • A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. 
  • Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. 
  • Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day. 
  • A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it. 
  • Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 

Extra Awesome Points For 

  • Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement. 
  • Familiarity with platform products where you expose APIs for others to build on. 

 

What We Offer 

  • A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective. 
  • A flat, flexible structure. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way. 
  • A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich. 
  • Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan. 
  • Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role. 
  • Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations. 
  • 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge. 
  • Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered. 

 

How You'll Make an Impact 

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we can bring our platform to new markets, and the systems you help build will make life easier for every property that runs on Apaleo. Your voice matters here, and your impact will be easy to see. 

Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Turkish Speaking
description:
Ready to Take on a New Challenge in Enterprise Sales?

Are you a driven, energetic sales professional looking for your next big adventure? Do you thrive on taking ownership, unlocking strategic accounts, and closing complex, high-value deals in a fast-paced environment? Are you excited by cutting-edge technology in a dynamic industry, and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact; not just on your career, but on the world?

 

If so, we want to hear from you. This role covers the Turkish market, so fluency in Turkish is essential.

 

Where You’ll Make an Impact:

  • As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll join our high-performing EMEA sales team, reporting to the Regional Sales Manager and VP EMEA. You'll take full ownership of your territory and become a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the Crypto and Financial Services landscape.

  • You’re not just here to sell, you’re here to transform how leading enterprises combat crypto crime with Elliptic’s industry-leading compliance and investigation solutions. You’ll gain deep product expertise and apply your understanding of evolving global and regional regulations to build compelling business cases that speak directly to our customers’ pain points.

 

This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking for a role where you can make an impact not just on the company you work for but also on the market you work in. Fascinating and challenging work is the norm - working at Elliptic is never boring!

 

What you will do:

  • Run the full enterprise sales cycle, from pipeline generation to deal closure, across a territory with massive potential and that has considerable inbound interest.

  • Proactively identify, engage, and convert strategic enterprise accounts (including pre-defined targets and new prospects).

  • Develop and execute multi-threaded sales strategies to engage diverse stakeholders (compliance, legal, risk, procurement, tech, C-level).

  • Handle 5-, 6- and 7-figure deal cycles with skill, creativity, and precision leveraging persuasion, influence, and value based selling techniques.

  • Drive account expansion through timely up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, maximizing value delivered to our customers.

  • Partner with global peers to collaborate on multi-region and strategic global accounts with long-term growth potential.

  • Collaborate with internal sales engineers, product experts, customer success, and marketing, as well as partner channels, to expand your reach and velocity.

  • Stay ahead of industry shifts and translate emerging challenges into opportunities for Elliptic’s solution suite.

  • Represent Elliptic at key industry events and conferences to strengthen relationships and identify new prospects.

  • Be an ambassador of the Elliptic brand, living our values of curiosity, trust, and action in every interaction.

 

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Completed Elliptic's product certifications and onboarding processes.

  • Mapped your territory, identified your top 20 target accounts, and built a qualified pipeline of at least 3x your quarterly quota through a combination of inbound, outbound, and partner-sourced opportunities.

  • Identified upsell or cross-sell motion in an existing Elliptic account in your territory and have it actively in play to build a qualified pipeline of at least 2x of your quarterly quota through proactive whitespace mapping and engagement in collaboration with the Customer Success Managers.

  • Run complete discovery cycles with at least 10 enterprise prospects, using the Value Pyramid to connect client pain points to our solutions, applying MEDDPPICC to qualify or disqualify with confidence, and have a clear view of what you're walking away from and why.

  • Progressed at least 2 opportunities to late-stage negotiation and closed your first deal, demonstrating you can manage the full enterprise cycle from initial engagement through legal and procurement.

  • Built multi-threaded relationships across your strategic accounts - compliance, risk, and C-suite - not just a single champion per account.

  • Earned a reputation internally with your SE, CS, marketing, and partner team as a well-prepared, collaborative account owner who closes the loop and uses internal resources without wasting them.

 

You will be a great fit here if you are:

  • A driven, tenacious “hunter” who thrives on owning their number and finding creative ways to exceed it.

  • Experienced in B2B enterprise SaaS and/or DaaS sales within RegTech, FinTech, and/or Crypto.

  • A proven track record of consistently closing successful enterprise deals across multiple years and companies.

  • Comfortable leading complex, long-cycle and large deals involving multiple stakeholders, but also agile enough to take on quick-close 5-figure deals.

  • Commercially curious, you ask smart questions, seek to understand the "why" behind a customer’s problems, and use those insights to tailor impactful solutions.

  • Confident, consultative, and persuasive, able to build strong stakeholder relationships at all levels, from mid-level managers to C-suites.

  • A collaborative team player, independent yet never a “lone wolf.” You value and engage support from your pack.

  • Agile, resourceful, and fearless, you see opportunity where others see blockers and know how to create inroads where none appear to exist.

  • Willingness to travel to customers and industry events and conduct business face to face.

 

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Fluency in Turkish (written and spoken) is essential, along with professional proficiency in English.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to establish meaningful relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders.

  • Technical acumen with the ability to establish credibility with technical decision makers.

  • Driven and solutions-oriented: you know how to navigate roadblocks and keep deals moving forward.

  • Familiarity with the MEDDPPICC methodology and Value Based Selling.

  • Proficiency in CRM systems (HubSpot or similar), LLMs and other AI-driven prospecting and work efficiency tools.

  • Passionate about generative AI and excited to help customers navigate a rapidly evolving industry.

 

Bonus Points for:

  • An existing network of connections across the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) space.

  • Additional languages beyond Turkish and English such as fluency in French, Spanish, or Italian.

  • A proven use case and understanding of agentic AI is a strong plus.

 

Ultimately we are looking to hire those who want to be the future leaders in the industry, super intrigued by Crypto and have an awesome mindset to learn so if you don’t meet all the criteria still do apply!

  • Share Options

  • Collaborative, flexible and friendly environment: We understand that flexibility is the key to maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • Social events, which include regular team lunch on us, quarterly full day events and an annual company 3-day event - this year these are taking place virtually

title: (Senior) Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

Our Talent Acquisition team is searching for a (Senior) Talent Acquisition Partner. You will play a pivotal role in helping Moss attract and hire the right talent for our tech positions, especially across Engineering. Reporting to the TA Director, you will join a team of five Talent Acquisition Partners across Berlin and London, covering every market and every role up to C-suite.

Your responsibilities

  • Sourcing, screening & managing candidates - identify, attract and engage with talent by using different sourcing techniques and channels. Manage the entire candidate journey from initial contact, coordinating interviews to offer management, ensuring a high quality candidate experience.

  • Business Partnering - Own full-cycle hiring for your vertical end to end, from sourcing through offer, across all locations. Work directly with the leadership and hiring managers on all their hiring needs. Develop deep understanding of the businesses you support to help them make better hiring decisions, not just fill vacancies.

  • Process improvement - Identify opportunities to reduce friction points across the interview process and the candidate journey, and implement experiments and improvements. Share sourcing techniques and hiring intelligence with the wider TA team across verticals and markets.

  • AI & Tooling - Contribute to making us more efficient and faster by leveraging existing AI workflows and helping us build new ones (Claude, chatGPT, n8n).

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role:

  • Track record sourcing and closing high-calibre and hard-to-reach candidates, including through sourcing and direct outreach.

  • Proven experience as a full-cycle recruiter working across technical roles.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools across daily recruiting workflow (a big plus if you're the one building them).

  • Fluent in English (C1 minimum).

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Inquisitive mindset - you ask sharp, insightful questions to really understand stakeholders and candidates

  • Good judgement - you weigh information and observations to make sound judgement calls in ambiguous situations.

  • Trustworthy and credible - you manage expectations, and build relationships based on a desire to help and support.

  • Adaptive communication - you bring structure and clarity to how you present information, and this enables you to guide, advise, and influence those you engage with.

The interview process will include an online assessment as an initial step, followed by an Intro Call, Hiring Manager Call, a Live Case Study and a Final In-person Interview in one of our offices.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. Als Data Engineer bringst du Datenlösungen eigenverantwortlich zum Laufen: Du entwickelst Pipelines und Datenmodelle innerhalb etablierter Plattformarchitekturen, betreust sie im Betrieb und verbesserst sie kontinuierlich. Architekturfragen entscheidest du nicht allein, du bringst dich aber mit eigenen Vorschlägen aktiv ein und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung für eigene Themenbereiche wie Datenqualität, Orchestrierung oder DataOps.

  • Entwicklung, Test und Betrieb von ETL-/ELT-Pipelines für Batch- und Streaming-Verarbeitung, z. B. mit Python, SQL, Spark, dbt oder Airflow

  • Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von Datenmodellen in bestehenden Lakehouse- und Data-Warehouse-Architekturen, z. B. auf Basis von Star-Schema, Normalformen oder Data Vault

  • Anbindung und Harmonisierung von Quellsystemen – etwa relationale Datenbanken, REST-APIs, Event-Streams oder ERP-Systeme

  • Entwicklung wiederverwendbarer Transformations- und Reporting-Layer für Analytics- und KI-Anwendungsfälle

  • Sicherstellung von Datenqualität durch Validierungsregeln, Reconciliation-Prozesse und Root-Cause-Analysen bei Auffälligkeiten

  • Orchestrierung, Scheduling und Monitoring von Datenlösungen im laufenden Betrieb – in Cloud- wie in On-Premise- und Hybridumgebungen

  • Analyse und Optimierung von Queries, Datenmodellen und Workloads mit Blick auf Laufzeit und Kosten

  • Mitarbeit an Architekturentscheidungen und Lösungsdesigns im Team sowie konstruktives Hinterfragen bestehender Entwürfe

  • Bereitstellung qualitativ hochwertiger, KI-fähiger Datensätze und Abstimmung von Schnittstellen mit KI- und Backend-Teams

  • Einsatz KI-gestützter Werkzeuge und generativer KI zur Unterstützung von Entwicklung, Dokumentation, Tests und Qualitätssicherung

  • Weiterentwicklung von CI/CD- und DataOps-Praktiken, Versionskontrolle mit Git sowie Dokumentation von Datenmodellen und Transformationslogik

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen, Fachbereichen und interdisziplinären agilen Teams, inklusive Prototyping und Anforderungsklärung

  • Schrittweise Übernahme von Verantwortung, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Governance, Security, Observability oder Code-Qualität

  • Unterstützung von Junior-Kolleg:innen im Tagesgeschäft und Teilnahme an Code-Reviews


  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im IT- oder MINT-nahen Umfeld oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Ca. 3–5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Data Engineering, Data Warehousing oder im Betrieb von Datenplattformen

  • Gute Kenntnisse in SQL sowie in mindestens einer Programmiersprache im Data-Umfeld, idealerweise Python

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einer Cloud- oder Datenplattform, z. B. Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake oder Microsoft Fabric

  • Erfahrung mit Werkzeugen des Modern Data Stack und der Orchestrierung, z. B. dbt, Spark oder Airflow

  • Solides Verständnis von Datenmodellierung, Datenintegration sowie ETL-/ELT- und Streaming-Verfahren

  • Erfahrung in Datenqualität, Monitoring und im Umgang mit Governance- und Security-Anforderungen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Git, CI/CD und automatisierten Tests

  • Offenheit für den reflektierten Einsatz KI-gestützter Werkzeuge im Engineering-Kontext

  • Erfahrung in agilen Entwicklungsmethoden (Scrum/Kanban)

  • Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Arbeit im Team

  • Offene und wertschätzende Kommunikation im Austausch mit Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2 Niveau

  • Englischkenntnisse auf B2 Niveau

  • Wohnsitz in Deutschland, idealerweise Nähe Ratingen/Frankfurt

Dann bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit ERP-Daten, insbesondere SAP-Datenstrukturen

  • Erste Berührung mit Infrastructure as Code und Containern, z. B. Terraform, Docker oder Kubernetes

  • Erfahrung mit Analytics- und BI-Werkzeugen wie Power BI, Qlik oder Tableau

  • Kenntnisse im Open-Source-Daten-Ökosystem, z. B. Apache-basierten Technologien

Das erwartet dich:

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Sunday creates pocket-sized friends for the mass market. We turn idle moments into meaningful connections for millions of users worldwide.

Sunday focuses on the psychology of care, companionship, and empathy. We build accessible worlds where players don't just solve puzzles, they rescue friends. By combining mass-market accessibility with deep emotional hooks, we are defining the next era of digital entertainment.

As Engineering Manager, you will lead Sunday's engineering team of approximately ten engineers across Unity game development and SDK. The position reports to the Director of Operations and works in close partnership with Production, Product, and Growth.

The role combines people leadership with technical ownership. Your primary responsibility is to lead and develop the team and to define how engineering operates. At the same time, you remain close enough to the code to own architectural decisions, review critical work and contribute directly where this supports delivery.

Our team delivers frequent releases across a portfolio of live games. We are looking for a leader who understands the trade-offs between quality, time and budget in the context of business priorities, and who translates them into sound technical decisions and the management of the team. This includes making our delivery pace sustainable through stable releases, a well-maintained codebase and engineering practices that scale with the business. The role carries a clear mandate to shape how engineering works at Sunday.

What you will own

  • People leadership: development plans, performance conversations against clear role expectations, hiring and onboarding. You hold conversations early and directly.

  • Engineering ways of working: code review standards, quality gates before release, build and release pipeline, and a deliberate plan to reduce hotfixes and technical debt.

  • Architecture and platform: owning the technical foundations shared across our games, including our in house SDK, analytics tracking, live configuration and the setup of A/B tests.

  • Delivery partnership: working with the producers who lead our cross functional game teams on estimates, capacity and technical risk, and having the final say on whether a release is technically ready to ship.

  • Transparency: making engineering progress, quality and capacity visible to the rest of the company through clear, measurable indicators.

What you bring

  • At least four years managing an engineering team of five or more people, including performance management and hiring.

  • A strong engineering background of your own, ideally in C#, Unity or mobile development, so you can lead architecture and review decisions with credibility.

  • A proven track record of success in a commercially driven company operating live products with real users, where engineering decisions are made against business priorities.

  • A track record of raising quality and delivery predictability in a small or fast moving company, with concrete examples of what you changed and how you measured it.

  • Comfort with direct conversations and with holding people to clear standards: Open, respectful, goal orientated.

  • A pragmatic, data driven approach: you decide based on what the numbers show, and you introduce the process only where it pays back.

Strong plus

  • Experience in frequent shipping of mobile games, ideally free to play, casual or hybrid casual titles.

  • Hands on knowledge of ad monetisation and mediation SDKs, mobile measurement partners and A/B testing infrastructure.

  • Experience introducing CI/CD, automated testing or release quality gates in a game studio.

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

  • Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

  • Easy Arrival to Sunday: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at applike in Hamburg? We support every ambition - from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

  • Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster Lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

  • Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

If you want to build the future of digital companionship, Sunday is your home. Apply now!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders)
description:
Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users, runs on €400k of AWS per year, and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers. Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving.

You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments.

Your role

  • You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend.

  • You work alongside our two external partners as the in-house technical counterpart – building the architecture and standards together, and bringing the deep platform knowledge back into the company. As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support.

  • You own our AWS spend – €400k a year that currently has no dedicated owner, including where it goes and how we bring it down.

  • You are the escalation point. When production is at risk, you decide.

  • You report directly to the Head of eCommerce Platforms, with direct access to leadership for the decisions that need it.

What you'll own

  • AWS infrastructure – EC2, RDS, Fargate, CloudFront, S3, IAM – plus Cloudflare, DNS and WAF

  • Security & compliance – DevSecOps practices, system audits, patching and access reviews, and GDPR-compliant data handling across every environment

  • Infrastructure as code – taking us from manually managed to fully Terraform-defined

  • Data layer – MySQL under production load: tuning, replication, and backups you have actually restored from

  • Cloud economics – a €350k annual AWS budget with real headroom for optimisation

  • Delivery for 30+ developers – Bitbucket Pipelines, environments, and how fast and safely code reaches production

  • Reliability at 7M MAU – monitoring, logging, alerting and incident response (New Relic, Sentry, CloudWatch, PagerDuty)

Your profile

  • 7+ years running production infrastructure, with deep hands-on AWS as the person accountable when it breaks

  • Security-conscious infrastructure operations – DevSecOps practices, system audits and access reviews, comfortable being accountable for GDPR-relevant data handling

  • Infrastructure as code at scale – Terraform as your default way of working, on an estate of comparable size

  • Deep Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) – you can trace a slow system from the kernel up and explain what you found

  • MySQL under real load – slow-query analysis, replication, indexing, tested recovery

  • Ownership of monitoring and incident response at scale – you have built the alerting that catches problems before customers report them, using tooling like New Relic, Datatog, etc. and run the on-call and post-incident process around it

  • Experience defining standards that other engineers work to, whether with in-house teams or external partners, and holding the line on them

Nice to have

  • PHP-FPM / Magento 2 performance tuning, or Varnish and Redis at scale

  • Cloud cost optimisation at six-figure annual spend

  • AWS architecture certification

  • Experience with SIEM tooling (e.g. Wazuh) or similar security monitoring

  • Background in direct-to-consumer eCommerce or other high-traffic system operations

Our stack

Magento 2 · PIM · PHP · MySQL · Redis · Varnish · Docker · AWS · Terraform · Bitbucket Pipelines · New Relic · Sentry · CloudWatch · PagerDuty · Cloudflare

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

We are looking forward to your application!

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.
